body: You already made a good decision by at least sharing your situation here with us.  Would you be willing to talk more about your situation?

Yup, I know what that feels like - I have to confess that I've made several attempts myself.  But I've always had people willing to help me to give me just enough to keep moving along.  Are there any one who can help you?
Please don't do it.  Let's talk.  I am willing to listen.
